preregistered_design.direction_rule: one independent namespaced torch.float64 Gaussian parameter vector per family/proposal index, normalized jointly across that family's parameters; the same direction is reused across multipliers
preregistered_design.acceptance_rule: accept only if every C4 sector support mask at bad/medium/good remains bitwise identical; invalid evaluations fail closed separately
preregistered_design.interpretation: synthetic feasibility diagnostic only; not loss-gradient optimization, threshold approval, or a frozen protocol

rollback_trajectory_design.direction_rule: independent deterministic namespaced unit-Gaussian direction per segment
rollback_trajectory_design.rollback_rule: compare each proposed segment to its current accepted support; on any mask change or invalid evaluation restore the exact prior parameters
rollback_trajectory_design.trapping_diagnostic: accepted-step fraction, zero-accepted trajectory count, net parameter motion, PMF L1 motion, physical-amplitude RMS motion, and VA motion

conclusion_scope: one deterministic initialization and three representative validation states; no global optimization-domain feasibility claim
